title.narrative: P.E.A.C.E. Rights - (Protecting, Empowering Activists & Communities to Enhance Rights)

description.narrative:
Overall objective of the project is to contribute to resilient, equal, and democratic societies, promoting political pluralism, inclusiveness, and active citizenship, while protecting and empowering human rights defenders and preserving civic space.

Specific objectives include:

1. Protection ensured, and capacity built among human rights defenders, and civil society organizations to maintain space to be able to operate freely.

2. Enhanced levels of political pluralism, inclusiveness and active citizenship, with a particular focus on youth and women¿s participation in public and political life.
